invariants.avoid: Passing the dependency through a static factory that still calls new keeps the bypass. Register the class and inject it.
invariants.fixHint: List the provider class in the module and declare it as a constructor parameter where it is used.

relations.why: NEST-INJ-001 tells callers to receive providers as constructor parameters, the Nest idiom being private readonly parameter properties, which TS-LEGACY-005 denies.
relations.settle: Nest also injects plain constructor parameters: declare the field and assign it in the constructor body to satisfy both, or exclude Nest controllers and providers from TS-LEGACY-005.

source.locator: providers and custom providers with useClass
source.paraphrase: Providers are classes the injector builds. Modules list the class and consumers declare it as a dependency.

invariants.why: A new-built provider duplicates singleton state, so two writers diverge and tests cannot substitute the module graph.

invariants.avoid: Scope.TRANSIENT is a separate scope and is allowed here. Only Scope.REQUEST matches.
invariants.fixHint: Drop the scope option for the default singleton, or pass request state as a method argument.

source.paraphrase: Providers are singletons by default. Request scope rebuilds the provider subtree for every request.

invariants.why: Request scope is supported for request-specific state; it can increase per-request allocations, so review the tradeoff.

invariants.avoid: transform: true without whitelist still passes unknown properties. Only whitelist or forbidNonWhitelisted counts.
invariants.fixHint: Construct the pipe with { whitelist: true }, and add forbidNonWhitelisted: true to reject instead of strip.

source.paraphrase: ValidationPipe strips properties that have no decorator when whitelist is set, closing mass assignment.

invariants.why: Without whitelist an attacker sets admin flags and relation ids that no DTO decorator mentions.

invariants.avoid: A quoted key or a forRootAsync factory that returns synchronize: true is the same setting. A condition such as NODE_ENV === "development" is allowed. Test and e2e files are not checked. An options object built outside the call is not seen.
invariants.fixHint: Set synchronize: false and apply schema changes with TypeORM migrations, or derive the flag from configuration so production never receives true.

source.paraphrase: Don't use synchronize: true in production; otherwise, you can lose production data.

invariants.why: With synchronize on, TypeORM alters the schema at startup to match the entities, so a renamed or removed column drops its production data.

source.paraphrase: Guards, interceptors, pipes, and exception filters are providers managed by the Nest IoC container and must be decorated with @Injectable() (or @Catch() for filters).

invariants.why: Omitting @Injectable() prevents TypeScript from emitting constructor design:paramtypes metadata, causing Nest DI resolution to fail when dependencies are injected.
invariants.fixHint: Add @Injectable() (or @Catch(...) on an ExceptionFilter) above the class declaration.
invariants.avoid: Only classes with an explicit implements clause for CanActivate, NestInterceptor, PipeTransform, or ExceptionFilter are checked.
